dex.entry: A revived fossil-crustacean that has grown larger and harder; its shell now has genuine crevasse-deep ridges and it moves along cave floors with quiet authority. The fossil mid-form that looks genuinely ancient — evolution as palaeontology.

art.silhouette: Larger segmented crustacean; thick ridged carapace in layered grey-cream; heavy claws useful for gripping rock; wide eyes set at the edge of its head-plate; moves with a side-to-side deliberate walk.
